Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the product looked promising. Our legal and procurement teams reviewed the latest MSA and sent back a compact set of redlines; they'd like to get them on a call and also align on a tighter onboarding cadence so we can meet our internal go-live date (September).

Can Redwood run a focused MSA review (30–45m) followed immediately by a 60m onboarding checkpoint (SRE + SE + legal) on the same day? Our team prefers stacked sessions to reduce context switching. Attached is the redline (Novus_MSA_Redline_v3.docx) and a preliminary onboarding checklist.

Proposed days: Tue Aug 3 or Thu Aug 5 (US Pacific). We can shift times earlier/later to accommodate Europe. Please advise who from Redwood should join (legal, SE, solutions engineer).

Thanks,

Elena

Head of Procurement
Novus Health

Hi Elena —

Thanks for sending the redline and the checklist. We can absolutely do stacked sessions. Suggested plan from our side:

- 30–45m MSA walk (Legal + Procurement + Account Exec)
- 60m onboarding checkpoint (SE + SRE + Implementation PM)

Suggested Redwood attendees: Ben Carter (Legal escalation & contracts), Marissa Cole (Customer Success / implementation), Hannah Schmitt (Legal ops). If that lineup looks good, we'll propose slots.

Proposed time windows (PT):
- Tue Aug 3: 10:00–12:00 or 14:00–16:00
- Thu Aug 5: 09:30–11:30 or 15:00–17:00

If Novus wants earlier EU-friendly times we can push to 08:00 PT for the legal session. I've attached a short agenda template.

I'll coordinate internally and send a calendar invite once we lock the precise timings. Also tagging Marissa and Ben to confirm capacity.

Best,

- I have a customer-facing workshop Aug 3 from 11:00–13:00 PT; I can do the 14:00–16:00 slot.
- Ben is limited on Aug 5 afternoon due to an internal review meeting.

Recommend we propose Thu Aug 5, 09:30 (legal) then 10:15 (onboarding), or Tue Aug 3, 14:00 (legal) then 14:45 (onboarding). That compresses handover but keeps sessions readable.
